title: H2-F: the framed transfer does not use the H2-sem no-target-feedback clause (F4 admissible; no new kappa)
body:
## Scope and question

Card `bit-helper-contract` (bit-mechanisms track), picker nonce `2276dce171053917945d67a485ce77f3` (priority revision 5; catalogue SHA `7d185cd8c2af35988d638d969748ad7b670f902606444dbfc748e4402c340df6`). Scope refined from the card to the merged `research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission` package's recorded second open next question: **is PR1194's H2-sem condition 2 (no target feeds a source/helper, inside D) necessary at the framed level, or does a weaker replacement admit the F4-shaped target-feeding wrap?**

Claim and investigation thread: [discussions/2684](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2684) (opened 2026-10-15T17:30Z), pointer on the predecessor's #1166 handoff. Base `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30` (canonical main, fetched 2026-10-15T17:21Z; none of the package's pinned inputs changed between it and the pin base `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`); selected-record SHA `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

## Result (scoped interface admission; no pricing, no supplier adoption, no new kappa)

H1's role in the interleaved scalar-interface lemma (the #543 lemma text in `research/e8-bit-r420/README.md`) is confined to the z-gate transvection induction over the gates of W0 = (A, scatter, B) and the cleanup C; the D section enters the lemma only as the operator y -> y + N s. Under the PR1194 substitution bridge, the lemma is invoked on the virtual splice word and the actual D prefix is transferred by coefficient-matrix equality on all 661 basis columns with identical state and frames at the D/A cut. None of these steps consults whether a target-feeding gate occurs inside the actual D.

Instance-verified on the pinned selected R439 word by rebuilding the F4 wrap through the predecessor package's own unmodified module:

- every semantic premise passes: H2-sem condition 1 (zero frame, distinct operands from targets and helpers), the complete D operator exact on all 661 basis columns, cut state/frames equal to baseline, semantic N = K;
- every conclusion component of the unchanged `xcheck_p.py` passes (U, J, Uinv; K semantically);
- only the three global syntactic flags fail — exactly the predecessor certificate's recorded list (`H1_no_target_feeds_z`, `H2_D_frame0_targets_from_helpers`, `K_equals_D`), with the D read count 18154 matching;
- the clause's protective work is shown to be carried by the semantic conditions through three new controls: N1 uncompensated feed (67 target columns move), N2 compensation by the wrong target (67 columns), N3 restore moved past the fed target's own gate (the fed helper's identity row breaks);
- F5's source feed stays inadmissible through condition 1 together with the framed replay's nested-climb rejection, re-checked here without condition 2.

Conclusion: with condition 1, the boundary equation and the D/A cut-state discipline in place, condition 2 is not used anywhere in the framed transfer — it is a conservative retention. The F4 class is admissible under the weaker explicit contract; nothing else changes.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-h2sem-cond2-framed-transfer/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-h2sem-cond2-framed-transfer --check-only
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_R439_H2SEM_COND2_FRAMED_TRANSFER columns=661 compensated_rows=67 n1_columns=67 n2_columns=67 controls=6 no_new_kappa
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

Standard library only; about two to four minutes. Verified on two independent Python 3.12 environments (the verifier alone is host-independent; the blob-pin phase of `research_package.py` uses `git cat-file --batch -z`, which needs git >= 2.42).

## Overlap

Submission-refreshed `find_overlap.py` (2026-10-15T17:26Z snapshots, 782 open PRs / 1320 discussion records, complete pagination): the only matches for this question are this package, its claim thread (#2684) and the predecessor package's own records. The target-feedback *pricing* side is open #2567 (at most eight registers, unit-cost single-source gates) and discussions /1290 and /1544 — a different question from this interface-level necessity result, and not touched here.

## Not claimed

No priced construction or saving (the F4 wrap adds 69 reads); no supplier adoption (F/B envelopes, the 104/192-bit guards, hosted costs and the paid profile were not recomputed for any variant); no change to the selected record, the selected bit supplier or `upstream/`; the outer assembly, all-size compiler, hosting, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations are untouched; a passing metadata check is not mathematical acceptance of the result.
